size.value: One passport-size photo (3.5 × 4.5 cm), required for visa applications submitted through Lebanese embassies

cross_verification.note: General Security (GDGS) post 61 is the visa-application-via-embassy page and states 'One passport-size photo (3.5 × 4.5 cm)' — matches DB exactly, no conflict. The page does not restate background/expression/glasses/headwear rules for the visa photo specifically, so those were left unverified rather than assumed identical to the lb-passport spec (see lb-passport.json), even though both are administered by the same authority.
